songs.title: The High Road to Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage
lines: O the road to Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage winds ancient and long,
Where the wardens of the Maormer Isles of Pyandonea still march with a song;
Keep your lantern trimmed bright through the mist and the rain,
Till the gates of Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage rise before us again.

songs.title: Watchfires of the Maormer Isles of Pyandonea
lines: Raise a cup for the Maormer Isles of Pyandonea, where the old beacons gleam,
Above ruin and valley, by causeway and stream;
Though the borderlands shift and the smugglers may scheme,
Still the folk of Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage keep the ancestors' dream.

songs.title: Boundary Stones of Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage
lines: From the pass to the harbour the mile-pillars stand,

Count the leagues into Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage with steel in your hand,
For the spirits of the Maormer Isles of Pyandonea bow to no stranger's command.

songs.title: Lamplight in Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage
lines: When the dusk settles deep over the Maormer Isles of Pyandonea's wide shore,

May the wards of Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage hold the night-wind at bay,
Till the horns of the morningwatch welcome the day.

notes.title: Surveyor's Field-Log at Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs
notes.author: Geographical Chroniclers' Guild
pages: On the fourteenth day of our circuit through the Atmoran Ice Waste, we set our transit-rod at Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs (survey grid 900, -11800 under the Windhelm Charter Expedition). The foundations here show three distinct strata of occupation, and our local guide from Jylkurfyk Ice Tombs refused to camp within forty paces of the threshold after sundown.

pages: Field entry recorded at Ka Po' Tun Dragon Sea Vault (ka_po_tun_dragon_sea_vault) in Ka Po Tun (akavir/ka_po_tun). Wardens inspecting this sea vault catalogued weathered boundary stones, supply tallies, and threshold seals.
